visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The male creator, sporting a black baseball cap and dark-framed glasses, stands in an outdoor transit-like environment with a high industrial ceiling. He holds a large cup of milk tea with a festive red-and-white mascot logo directly towards the camera lens. His facial expression is animated as he speaks, and he is wearing a dark blue sweatshirt with yellow PATRIOTS lettering. (2) A transition reveals a bright red shop counter where employees in black branded t-shirts and blue protective gloves are working. A decorative orange pumpkin bucket, typically used for Halloween, is placed on the counter and is completely filled with discarded or waiting receipt papers. The lighting is bright and typical of a fast-food or retail establishment. (3) The video displays a digital self-service kiosk showing colorful images of Fresh Lemonade, Mango Pomelo, and Signature King Cone with prices listed in Singapore dollars. A hand is seen tapping the screen to adjust sugar levels to 30%. Subsequently, a hand holds a smartphone near a payment terminal to complete a contactless transaction. (4) In a montage, the creator takes a sip of the drink through a thick straw, followed by a woman in a light-colored sleeveless top also tasting a beverage. Close-up shots emphasize the textures of black pearls, white pearls, and red beans settled at the bottom of a plastic cup. The segment concludes with a wide shot of the MIXUE storefront featuring its iconic snowman mascot.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 人生第一口. [Logo]: MIXUE. (2) [Subtitle]: 蜜雪冰城. (3) [Subtitle]: 第一次來有推薦的嗎. (4) [Variety]: (異口同聲🤨). [Subtitle]: 蜜桃四季春. (5) [Subtitle]: 檸檬水啊. 檸檬水. $78台幣. 能客製冰塊甜度. (6) [Subtitle]: 冰淇淋. $44台幣. 店員也能點🤐. 最貴只要 $86台幣. 3杯飲料1支🍦 $346台幣. (7) [Subtitle]: 3分鐘就做好了. 謝謝. 掰掰. (8) [Subtitle]: $112台幣. 完蛋 我覺得台灣的手搖比較好喝. 好像放一陣子了. 咬起來 不是很新鮮的Q. 哦 裡面有點硬. (9) [Subtitle]: 可是它裡面的 紅豆還蠻特色的. 它除了黑色珍珠之外 還有白色珍珠. 他們賣的冰淇淋 $44台幣. 很奶很香. 麥當勞. (10) [Subtitle]: 店員推薦 蜜桃四季春. $118台幣. 它裡面有加椰果. 很甜 桃子味. 檸檬水. $78台幣. 最少的甜度是30%. 還是有點甜. (11) [Subtitle]: 這間的優點就是便宜. 別人賣到 $200台幣一杯. 他們只賣 $100台幣.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator begins speaking with a bright, enthusiastic tone and a rapid speech rate. Simultaneously, a fast-paced electronic pop background track featuring synthesized melodies and a driving 4/4 beat begins. The audio is crisp with high spectral brightness, typical of a produced vlog intro intended to grab immediate attention. (2) The narrator's voice is joined by a second male voice asking a question in a natural indoor environment with noticeable room resonance. This is followed by two female voices responding in unison with a bright, melodic intonation. The iconic Mixue brand jingle, a simple and repetitive melody, becomes the primary musical bed during this interaction. (3) High-pitched digital UI sound effects are layered over the narration, mimicking the sound of screen taps and transaction confirmations. The background ambience includes the muffled sounds of a busy service counter and distant mechanical hums. The phase ends with a clear, polite female voice saying Thank you and the narrator saying Bye bye. (4) A prominent liquid slurping sound occurs, followed by the narrator's critique of the drink's texture. His voice exhibits high pitch variability and dynamic intonation. The background music continues at a steady volume, maintaining the upbeat tempo. There is a secondary slurp sound as another beverage is sampled, accompanied by more verbal feedback. (5) The narrator concludes with a final summary of the price comparison, delivered with an authoritative yet casual tone. The intensity of the background music remains constant until the very end of the clip. The ambient noise floor of a shopping mall, characterized by distant chatter and footsteps, is audible beneath the voice and music layers.
